question: A and B can do a piece of work in 5 days. B and C can do the same work in 8 days. while C and A can do it in 16 days. Find the time (in days) in which A. B and C can finish the work: working together.
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a piece of work in 5 days.

B and C can do the same work in 8 days.

C and A can do it in 16 days.

**Formula Used:**

If A and B can do a piece of work in x days, B and C in y days, and C and A in z days, then they together will finish the work in (xyz)/(2(xy + yz + zx)) days.

**Calculation:**

Let the work done by A and B in 1 day = (1)/(5)

Work done by B and C in 1 day = (1)/(8)
